package.description: Software to warm up your computer display at night, to match your indoor lighting.

en-US.author: f.lux Software LLC
en-US.description: Software to warm up your computer display at night, to match your indoor lighting.
en-US.longDescription:
Ever notice how people texting at night have that eerie blue glow?
Or wake up ready to write down the Next Great Idea, and get blinded by your computer screen?
During the day, computer screens look good—they're designed to look like the sun. But, at 9PM, 10PM, or 3AM, you probably shouldn't be looking at the sun.
f.lux fixes this: it makes the color of your computer's display adapt to the time of day, warm at night and like sunlight during the day.
It's even possible that you're staying up too late because of your computer. You could use f.lux because it makes you sleep better, or you could just use it just because it makes your computer look better.
f.lux makes your computer screen look like the room you're in, all the time. When the sun sets, it makes your computer look like your indoor lights. In the morning, it makes things look like sunlight again.
Tell f.lux what kind of lighting you have, and where you live. Then forget about it. f.lux will do the rest, automatically.
en-US.name: f.lux

zh-CN.author: f.lux Software LLC
zh-CN.description: 在夜间为电脑显示器预热，以配合室内照明。
zh-CN.longDescription:
有没有注意过人在晚上发短信时会发出阴森的蓝光，或者一觉醒来准备记下好主意，却被电脑屏幕蒙蔽了双眼？
电脑屏幕在白天看起来不错——它们在设计上看上去和太阳差不多，但是到了晚上 9、10 点甚至凌晨 3 点，你不再需要看着太阳。
f.lux 可以解决这个问题：它能让电脑显示屏的颜色与一天中的时间相匹配，晚上看起来温暖，白天看起来像阳光。
你甚至有可能会因为电脑熬夜到很晚。如果想要睡得更好，或者只是让电脑看上去更好，你可以试试 f.lux。
f.lux 能随时让你的电脑屏幕和你所在的房间相匹配，在日落时让你的电脑看起来和室内灯光一样，在清晨时又会让一切看起来像阳光一样。
告诉 f.lux 你有什么样的灯光，以及你住在哪里，f.lux 会自动完成剩下的工作。
zh-CN.name: f.lux
